import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import gen as G

def timeit(req, label):
    line = json.dumps(req) + '\n'
    t0 = time.time()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=line, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    out = r.stdout.strip()
    print('%-38s %7.2fs  rc=%d  %s' % (label, dt, r.returncode, out[:120]))
    if r.stderr: print('   STDERR', r.stderr[:500])
    return dt

rng = random.Random(1)
cases = [
    ('equal cap3 path6 n8', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=8, pathlen=6, cap=3, equal=True)),
    ('equal cap1 path2 n11', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=11, pathlen=2, cap=1, equal=True)),
    ('equal cap11 path9 n9', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=9, pathlen=9, cap=11, equal=True)),
    ('unequal cap3 path6 n8', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=8, pathlen=6, cap=3, equal=False)),
    ('unequal cap1 path2 n11', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=11, pathlen=2, cap=1, equal=False)),
    ('equal cap5 path9 n22', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=22, pathlen=9, cap=5, equal=True)),
    ('equal cap15 path9 n20', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=20, pathlen=9, cap=15, equal=True)),
    ('equal cap2 path3 n10', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=10, pathlen=3, cap=2, equal=True)),
    ('equal cap8 path4 n12', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=12, pathlen=4, cap=8, equal=True)),
    ('equal cap2 path9 n64', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=64, pathlen=9, cap=2, equal=True)),
    ('equal cap4 path7 n64', G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=64, pathlen=7, cap=4, equal=True)),
    ('random big', G.gen_plan_big(rng, nf=22, nn=12)),
]
for label, req in cases:
    timeit(req, label)
